# Decentralized AI — distributed LLM inference benchmark

> PC + Android phone running one LLM through llama.cpp RPC. Measured: 24.98 tok/s single machine → 20.28 tok/s loopback RPC → 3.40 tok/s over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
> 中文：跨设备分布式推理实测。同一台笔记本 24.98 tok/s，零延迟回环 RPC 20.28 tok/s，把层分到手机上经 2.4GHz 链路 3.40 tok/s。

## Key facts

- Architecture tax of layer-pipelined inference: **19%** (24.98 → 20.28 tok/s, loopback RPC).
- Network tax over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi: **83%** (20.28 → 3.40 tok/s).
- Per-token network stall: **245 ms**, equal to about **7 round trips per token** on a 34 ms link.
- "LAN" is not a synonym: real switch 0.1–0.3 ms, 5 GHz Wi-Fi 3–6 ms, 2.4 GHz travel router 15–55 ms — a **50×** spread.
- Layer splitting adds **capacity, not speed** (layers are strictly serial).
- MoE (e.g. Qwen3-30B-A3B) is the only form where pooling keeps both capacity and usable speed.
- Useful only when: model exceeds one GPU, the organization will not buy GPUs, the task tolerates seconds of latency, and data cannot leave the intranet.

## Files

- `README.md` — full technical record, three-tier measurements, four corrected judgments, reproduction steps.
- `VISION.md` — the non-technical question: can a group of peers govern a shared resource with their own rules?
- `docs/同协异步-综述.md` — a survey of "collaborative asynchrony": consensus theory, swarm intelligence, decentralized training, commons governance; three testable propositions and a two-hour Mesa experiment design.
- `docs/知识引用集.md` — annotated bibliography (what it is / how it relates / which part to read / how long).
- `docs/references.bib` — BibTeX entries.
- `experiments/exp01_baseline.md` — raw experiment log.
- `PROGRESS.md` — daily progress notes.
